scientific_integrity: The theorem follows from an exact conditional e-value calculation, exact Gaussian first and second moments, and a monotone forward-difference argument. Numerical checks only corroborate the algebra. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Known-variance scalar Gaussian location model; simple null; deterministic split size; e-power is an expected-log criterion and need not maximize fixed-threshold rejection probability. A later 2025 exponential-dispersion mean-calibration preprint studies e-power and split sampling more broadly and remains a residual overlap risk, but the inspected material did not state the exact Gaussian optimizer or asymptotic phase laws claimed here.
title: Exact e-power split law for Gaussian universal likelihood ratios
